tools.name: get_heartbeat_status
tools.description: Get the live status of a Cronping check (up/down/new, last ping time, ping count, and whether an alert channel is set).

findings.detail: Description of "delete_heartbeat" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_heartbeat, set_heartbeat_alert · Private data: ping_heartbeat · Public sink: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat, set_heartbeat_alert · Destructive: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat, import_crontab, delete_heartbeat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_heartbeat, set_heartbeat_alert · Private data: ping_heartbeat · Public sink: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat, set_heartbeat_alert · Destructive: create_heartbeat, ping_heartbeat, import_crontab, delete_heartbeat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
